title: D365 Architect form definition
description: Declarative YAML shape for a Dynamics form, produced by `d365architect form export`.

form.description: The form's display name, e.g. "Account Main Form". Serialises as the top-level "form" key.

entity.description: Logical name of the table this form belongs to, e.g. "account" (the systemform's objecttypecode).

type.description: The kind of form this is, e.g. "Quick Create" or "Dashboard" — the systemform "type" option set's own label (see https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/developer/data-platform/reference/entities/systemform). Only present when it's something other than "Main" — an ordinary main form, and by far the most common case.

isDefault.description: Only present when true — a table typically has one default form per Type, and false is the common case for any given form.

formActivationState.description: "Inactive" for a form that hasn't been published/activated yet. Absent — Dataverse's "Active" state — is the common case for any form that's actually in use.

isCustomizable.description: Whether this form can be customized. Absent when Dataverse doesn't report it.

formXml.description: The form's layout and controls, as FormXML. Null for the same kind of internal/system case a view's FetchXML can be missing for — see FetchXml; not yet hit live for a form, but not assumed away either.
